'''Kara Corlon''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a hunter who resided on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] with a group of [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kara Corlon was a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on December 15, 2011.

*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' {{1st}}
